title: v2.1.293
content: What's changed Added Claude Haiku 5.5 ( claude-haiku-5-5 ), now the default Haiku model on the Anthropic API — 1M context, $0.10/$0.50 per Mtok ($0.50/$2.50 for prompts over 100K) Added agentType to the subagentStatusLine payload, so scripts can tell custom subagent types apart Added isDeferred to $.tool.register for mods: false lists the tool's schema in the prompt from the start instead of behind tool search Fixed Claude sometimes treating its own last actions before a context compaction as done after it, and retracting or redoing finished work Fixed a memory leak where an HTTP MCP connection kept every request it had sent until it closed Fixed a message sent while Claude was working being lost when ← moved the session to the background; if a queued message can't move, ← now stays put and says so Fixed /model effort ←/→ wrapping past the highest or lowest level, which could accidentally save Low as a model's default effort Fixed /tui disconnecting Claude in Chrome in a session starte
author: ashwin-ant
summary_zh: Claude Code v2.1.293 新增 Claude Haiku 5.5（claude-haiku-5-5），它现在是 Anthropic API 上的默认 Haiku 模型，支持 1M 上下文，价格为每百万 token 输入 $0.10、输出 $0.50（提示超过 100K 时为 $0.50/$2.50）。本版本还在 subagentStatusLine 中加入 agentType 字段，并为 $.tool.register 加入 isDeferred 选项。修复了三个问题：上下文压缩后 Claude 重做或撤回已完成工作、HTTP MCP 连接内存泄漏，以及切到后台时排队消息丢失。
pin_reason: 首次在 Claude Code 中引入 Haiku 5.5 并设为默认 Haiku 模型，具备 1M 上下文和低价格，是重要的模型版本里程碑。

title: Claude Haiku 5.5
content: As previously promised , here's Anthropic's new fast, low cost model: Introducing Claude Haiku 5.5 . The previous Haiku, 4.5, was very much showing its age. It came out almost a year ago , and was priced at $1/million input and $5/million output - relatively expensive even back then, and a full 10x the price of OpenAI's GPT-6 Luna , released last month. The new Haiku exactly matches the price of GPT-6 Luna - $0.10/$0.50 - up to 100,000 tokens. Beyond 100,000 tokens the price increases 5x to $0.50/$2.50. Luna itself has a price increase at 272,000 tokens but only to $0.20/$0.75. Haiku 5.5 also uses a new, less generous tokenizer. My Claude Token Counter tool shows that the same long prompt uses around 1.25x as many tokens with Haiku 5.5 compared to Haiku 4.5, so there's a hidden price increase there. If your workloads fit in 100,000 tokens, Haiku is the same price as Luna and reports higher benchmark scores. Above 100,000 tokens, Luna looks like a much better deal. The most recent relea
summary_zh: Simon Willison 解读 Anthropic 新发布的低价快速模型 Claude Haiku 5.5：输入和输出价格分别降到每百万 token $0.10 和 $0.50，与 OpenAI GPT-6 Luna 相同；输入超过 10 万 token 后价格涨到 5 倍。文章还指出新 tokenizer 不如旧版省 token，同样的长提示用量约为 Haiku 4.5 的 1.25 倍，等于变相涨价。这些信息适合用来评估 Claude 低成本模型在编程和批量 LLM 工作流中的实际成本。
pin_reason: Haiku 5.5 是 Claude 低成本模型线的重要版本更新，文章还给出了定价和 tokenizer 隐性成本的分析，选模型和估算成本时可以长期参考。

title: The Hidden Language Tax Making AI More Expensive for Non-English Users
content: Claude Opus 5 uses nearly 3x more tokens for Russian than English. Here's why AI tokenization makes some languages more expensive than others. Read All
author: Khasky
summary_zh: 文章指出 Claude Opus 5 处理俄语时消耗的 token 数量接近英语的 3 倍，并解释了分词机制为何让部分语言的 AI 使用成本更高。这对非英语用户（包括中文用户）控制 Claude Code 和 LLM 工作流的成本有参考价值，比如可以考虑用英语写提示词或 CLAUDE.md 来节省 token。

title: v0.2.164
content: Internal/Other Changes Updated bundled Claude CLI to version 2.1.292 CI: security hardening for GitHub Actions workflows that call Claude — egress-firewall runner, network allow list, auto permission mode, and a check workflow to enforce them ( #1329 ) CI: raised PyPI per-file limit guard to 250 MiB to match the updated project limit ( #1366 ) Tests: fixed thinking-deltas e2e test for CLI 2.1.287+ by using explicit thinking display options ( #1367 ) PyPI: https://pypi.org/project/claude-agent-sdk/0.2.164/ pip install claude-agent-sdk==0.2.164
author: github-actions[bot]
summary_zh: Claude Agent SDK Python v0.2.164 是一次以内部维护为主的小版本更新，内置的 Claude CLI 升级到 2.1.292。另一处值得关注的是 CI 安全加固：调用 Claude 的 GitHub Actions 工作流启用了出口防火墙 runner、网络白名单和 auto 权限模式，并新增检查工作流来强制执行这些规则，可作为在 CI 中安全运行 Claude 的参考。
